summary: Iter-16 — Validated the Preview Vault feature end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_preview_vault.py: 6/6 PASS covering seller open + persistence (status='preview', is_preview=true), idempotency (same room id on 2nd POST), buyer 403, agent flow on a freshly created listing, and the GET /api/drl-templates regression (HTTP 200). Frontend Playwright run on the public preview URL: as seller (mira) the /app/listings page shows 4 preview-vault-{lid} buttons; clicking one POSTs /api/listings/{lid}/preview-vault and navigates to /app/rooms/{roomId}, where the preview-vault-banner is rendered and the room status pill shows 'preview'. A second click on the same listing routes to the SAME room URL (frontend-level idempotency verified). On /app/rooms the preview-badge-{roomId} pill is present. As buyer (alex) the /app/listings page renders with no preview-vault buttons (buyer can't edit listings). All review-request acceptance criteria are met.

issues: Console SVG/HTML errors observed across pages: (a) elements rendered with src="" causing the browser to re-download the document; (b) several / attributes use raw CSS calc() / translate('50%, 50%') values which are invalid in SVG attribute syntax (Expected number, 'M calc(100% - 40px…' etc.). These are pre-existing decorative-svg issues unrelated to Preview Vault, but worth cleaning up.

action_items: (Optional, pre-existing) Sanitize the empty-src tags and the SVG path/transform values that contain CSS calc()/% strings — they spam the console with errors but do not block functionality.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/listings/{lid}/preview-vault (server.py:3690) correctly delegates to _listing_for_edit_or_404 for the edit-permission gate, so buyer 403 is enforced consistently with the rest of the listing-edit endpoints (DRY).

Idempotency is implemented as a simple find_one({listing_id, buyer_id, status:'preview'}) before insert — clean and correct. The (listing, user) pair is the natural key and no race condition is meaningful at human click cadence.

_clone_listing_files_into_room is wrapped in try/except with a logger.warning, so a clone failure (e.g. zero staged files, GridFS hiccup) never blocks the room creation — good defensive coding. The audit log records cloned_staged_files count for traceability.

auto-NDA-accept for preview vaults is set via nda_accepted_by_buyer_at = now_utc().isoformat(); this lets the seller pass participant_check and skip the NDA gate cleanly, which is required for the QA flow.
GET /api/drl-templates decorator is back at line 3748 and returns HTTP 200 — regression closed.
Frontend openPreviewVault (MyListings.jsx:219) correctly handles loading state (previewBusy) + toast on success/error + navigate; the button is disabled while in-flight to prevent double-submits.

DealRoomDetail.jsx renders the preview-vault-banner conditional on room.is_preview, so non-preview rooms don't accidentally show it. The status pill already has a 'pill-amber' branch for status==='preview'.
DealRooms.jsx renders the preview-badge-{r.id} pill conditional on r.is_preview, so non-preview rooms aren't affected — matches the spec.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the seller + buyer flows tested

rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Feature is correctly wired end-to-end. Backend gate (_listing_for_edit_or_404) blocks buyer at 403, idempotency holds, banner + status pill + rooms-list badge all render under the documented data-testids.
